verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents end-to-end voice latency numbers, benchmarks, or latency-tuning guidance. The speech-to-speech model option and the call-history performance metrics are adjacent features that make no latency claims, and the deploy-time claims concern setup speed, not conversational latency.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims
